reviews.text: Having never had a pool or a pool built, you guys were great. The process was well explained. Communication was constant regarding project progression and delays. Quality of work was beyond expectation as well the attention to detail. As a new pool owner “pool school” has me confident in maintaining the pool myself. Thank you all very much. We are looking forward to warmer weather and using our pool for years to come.
reviews.author: Dwayne Howerton

reviews.text:
I worked with Remington Custom Pools recently while looking into having a pool installed, and while we decided not to move forward with the project for now, I wanted to say how awesome their team was. Mike was super friendly, helpful, and really took the time to explain everything to me. I loved his design ideas, which really nailed what I was looking for. We didn't know that much about pools, but he really gave us some great options to think about.

Even though we’re not moving ahead right now, I really appreciate all their time and effort. When we decide to move forward with the pool, they will be the first place I contact.
reviews.author: Lindy Pham

reviews.text: Remington Luxury Pools was incredibly helpful throughout the entire process and greatly exceeded my expectations. Their attention to detail and dedication to quality truly stood out. The team was professional and made everything seamless from start to finish. I highly recommend them for anyone looking to create their dream pool.
reviews.author: Gerry Wood

reviews.text: These guys have done an amazing job building our dream pool! In just over 5 weeks, they completed our pool. Glen (project supervisor) has gone above and beyond, and has moved the project along quickly, as we wanted to get it done fast. The build quality is great, the subs have been very friendly and respectful, and the communication throughout has been awesome. I highly recommend these guys and have already sent friends to Cody to have their dream pool built. You won't regret using Remington Luxury Pools!
reviews.author: Hayden Harbold

reviews.text: Remington Pools built our pool and did an amazing job! We couldn't be more happy with the way it turned out and the timeline it was completed in. I highly recommend you have your pool built by these guys!
reviews.author: Haley Harbold

reviews.text: You could not find a better contractor for your pool! Share your vision with Matt and his team and they will make it a reality! By far, this is the best company to go with for your pool!
reviews.author: M V

reviews.text: The folks at Remington Pools do quality work and are good to work with to build a pool and outdoor living space. I recommend them!
reviews.author: Rick Beaulieu

reviews.text: We are really enjoying our new custom pool and Remington Luxury Pools made the design/build process easy and fun!
reviews.author: Dawn Frye
